fixed: hook: the title lands whole by about 0.4 s and the real Reykjavík year bursts out clockwise on a hit at 0.5 s (frame 15), holds, and folds back into the inner ring before the hand draws it; the footer ('approximate …') arrives with the burst so no data is ever on screen without the label
readout: month, a small 'about', and the hours at 44 px (square) / 55 px (vertical) inside the inner ring; the hedge stays on screen
the readout's hedge 'about' went from 22 px to 24 px (30 px vertical), on its own line between the month and the hours, so the load-bearing word of a learn study is not the smallest one in the stack
square end lines at 44 px beneath the title: the dial moved down 25 px and the end push-in ends at 1.03, so the Dec label and the footer stay clear
the first sweep ends at frame 300, and the hand lands on 21 Jun on the 330 hit and on 21 Dec on the 390 hit in both sizes: the readout and the callout always agree

punches: every callout snaps in on its hit (alpha in three frames, scale 0.6 through an overshoot), its point flashes a ring, the dial kicks 2%, and a soft pulse from the point every two beats keeps each hold alive
the Quito landing: the teal ring flashes thick and settles as it closes on a new hit at 570, with its callout snapping in on the same frame in both sizes (the vertical's was off-grid at 558)
sound: mood 'drive' with drop 90, so drums enter as the first sweep starts; hits at 15, 330, 390, 570, 630
the sweeps use a sine ease so their ends never stall (still-frames had found dead air there after the retime)
square callouts moved 10 px down so the June and Quito labels no longer crowd the May and Aug month labels
